_: The operating systems MXFS is released for, in development for, or planned for. Read and written by tools/platforms.py. status: released = a release claims it, so every release must pass its build_check and record a verification of that exact version (scripts/release.sh refuses to publish otherwise); development = worked on, never claimed; planned = not started. A defect's `platform` field (tools/defects.py) names one of these keys, or `any`.

freebsd14.name: FreeBSD 14
freebsd14.notes: A port, not a build target: MXFS is a fork of Linux XFS built as a Linux kernel module. The DLM layer sits behind the platform abstraction (pal/) and carries over; the filesystem needs a new FreeBSD VFS frontend and buffer cache integration (docs/future.md).
